children: Stewards ended an unfunded $1.5 million short-term bridge financing with Accretiv Investment Holdings and simultaneously terminated the related Security Agreement, effective Sep 21, 2026. No principal was advanced, the fixed $75,000 lender return was not earned, and no defaults occurred. The terminations were mutual with no fees or penalties, and Accretiv released any liens, agreeing to terminate any lien records if later identified. Stewards owes no amounts in connection with the cancelled financing.
